title: The frontend labels the documents task "Optional", telling a user they can skip it; DR1 lists it as a task to do and, if it is still undone at submission, tells the user to upload the health certificate before the import.

finding.frontend: The "5. Documents" section holds one row, "Uploaded documents", whose status is the bare word "Optional" rather than a tag. It never becomes "Completed" in the sense the other rows do, and because the review gate treats an optional row as satisfied (src/server/app/flow/section-status.js:11-15) a notification with no documents at all counts as ready to submit. The status comes from the documents collection carrying no minimum entry count (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/obligations/sections/documents.js:20-28).
finding.prototype: DR1's hub shows "Upload documents" with the same "To do" tag as every other task and turns it green once a document exists (app/routes.js:5810-5819). Submitting without one is allowed but not silent: the submission confirmation lists "upload the health certificate and any other required documents" among the things that must be done before the import (app/routes.js:5674-5692).
finding.difference: Stop rendering the documents row as "Optional" and give it the same to-do and complete statuses as the other tasks. If submission is still to be allowed without documents, the outstanding upload has to be carried forward and shown to the user afterwards, which is where the substance of the difference lies — DR1 does not treat the health certificate as skippable, only as deferrable.
finding.falsifiedBy: A frontend hub showing the documents row with a to-do or completed status tag rather than the word Optional.
finding.verification: Opened the fe-hub and dr1-notification-hub DOMs and screenshots, and read documents.js:19-28, bridge/status/index.js:87-99, bridge/status/classification/index.js:9-29, flow/section-status.js:11-15 and routes.js:5674-5692 + 5810-5819. Ran the falsifier: in the fe-hub DOM the documents status div holds the bare text "Optional" with no govuk-tag element, while every other startable row holds a <strong class="govuk-tag ...">. Traced the mechanism rather than trusting the citation — the documents obligation declares only `requires.maxEntries: 10`, so `isRequiredObligation` is false, `statusOf` takes the `required.length === 0` branch and returns OPTIONAL when unstarted; `readyForCheckYourAnswers` then counts OPTIONAL as satisfied, so a notification with no documents does open the review gate. On the DR1 side `getConditionalSubmissionItems` pushes 'upload the health certificate and any other required documents' when `hasUploadedDocuments` is false, and notification-submitted.html:27-37 renders those under "Before the consignment is imported / You still need to:", so the deferrable-not-skippable reading holds. All four cited ranges resolve to what the sentences say. CORRECT.

relatedTo.why: Optional is one of the statuses the frontend renders and DR1's two-status vocabulary does not have

This finding's difference slot says the outstanding upload has to be carried forward and shown to the user afterwards, and calls that the substance of the difference; that is wholly the other finding's work, on the confirmation page. Two findings, and the hub work stops at the row.
